annotations.title: Confirm the human owner with their emailed code

description: The backup to the one-click link: pass the six digit code your owner read from the NodNod email. On success the trial ends and your key can send Nods and spend. Five wrong tries closes the code; then call resend_owner_letter. Tries are also limited per key and per account (10 an hour, 20 a day). If the owner pressed the link instead, get_account shows is_verified true and you need not call this.
name: verify_owner
